test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 21 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All W are B.

II. All M are B.

**Conclusions:**

I.Some B are M.

II. All W are M.

III. All B are W.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow

solution:
First, we will draw the venn diagram of the statements as below:

1) All W are B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2045e18b327adcdcc4cba4e8c768958a871f1c47854a699eb8ed51f398b63e89.png] 

2) All M are B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8939aa295a78b6faca4add4684d446f68699635c83fc3b91b96132f2af509f3c.png] 

Thus, combining all the statements we will get,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e4136cb0b35cffbe73ec9b1a5e7ad6cccb7660932e169972607d4e0fc45ff53.png] 

Next, we will check the conclusions as:

I. Some B are M: Since all M are B and so some B are M. This is true.

II. All W are M: Since all W are B and all M are B. But there is no relation between M and W. This is not true.

III. All B are W: Since, all W are B given. So, some B are W but not all. This is not true.

Hence, the __**conclusion I**__ is true.
